title: Compiler trace timeline: serial LTO link bottleneck
what: lto_link duration (s), its share of total build time (%), or total build wall time (s)

reader_questions.question: Which compiler stage is the biggest bottleneck and how much of the build does it take?
reader_questions.expected: lto_link takes 51.8 s (43.8% of the 118.4 s total build), running single-threaded.

reader_questions.question: Are the stage durations exact measurements from a single trace?
reader_questions.expected: Yes, exact microsecond trace timestamps from one profiled release build.

reader_questions.question: Would adding more parallel codegen threads fix the main bottleneck?
reader_questions.expected: No; all four codegen shards finish within 29.5 s, whereas serial lto_link alone takes 51.8 s.
